properties.description: One served read that takes a REQUIRED seed — the Component (or Capability) under work — and renders its black box in a code-like form: the requirements that box satisfies; each of its capabilities as a function header with its signature (name, inputs, outputs, kind) or an explicit "unsigned" marker; the Constraints and enforced DesignRules that bind it, with units and consequence; each Interface it provides or consumes as a port, `unspecified` shown as such, and for every port the far-side box as a header only; the parent's contract; nothing else. The region is the seed's containment closure plus a propagation radius — the same computation claim_region and scoped detect_gaps use — and the reply reports what it left out (share of the design in scope, total against in-scope) so a narrowed reference never reads as the whole. The whole design is refused as a seed: there is no unscoped form, by Anthony's word 2026-09-13 (chg:the-design-reference-capability-takes-a-required-seed) — "here is the whole car design again" is the failure this exists to avoid. Every line traces to a node id, so a fill-in is detectable; the reply reports its own size and the fraction of the box's capabilities unsigned. The same payload is what req:intent-is-reinjected re-injects into a long build. Not a persisted document and not a grammar: a projection over the schema that already exists, in the structured natural language language models already read. Planned 2026-09-13.
properties.name: The design reference for one black box — its function, constraints, ports and the far side of each port — is served compact and code-shaped for the implementing agent, derived from the graph on every read
